title: Unity Catalog model version converters: leave deployment_job_state None when the proto field is unset (guard with HasField)
answers: Why does a Unity Catalog model version show an empty deployment job state object with blank job_id and UNSPECIFIED states?
How is deployment_job_state hydrated when converting a UC model version or model version search result?
Where is the Unity Catalog model version proto-to-ModelVersion conversion done, and how do I add a new optional sub-message field there?
body:
Path: Converts Unity Catalog model version responses (get, search, and the native registry REST responses) into MLflow ModelVersion / ModelVersionSearch objects, including the deployment job state that links a version to its deployment job. Chokepoints: mlflow/utils/_unity_catalog_utils.py:model_version_from_uc_proto and model_version_search_from_uc_proto (Databricks UC proto), and mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/uc_native_rest_store.py:model_version_from_uc_native_proto and model_version_search_from_uc_native_proto (UC-native ModelVersionInfo proto).
Rule: Map an optional message field such as deployment_job_state with `ModelVersionDeploymentJobState.from_proto(...) if uc_proto.HasField("deployment_job_state") else None`. Calling from_proto on an unset field returns a truthy object full of empty strings, not None. Apply this to every converter that reads the field, since the four converters above must stay consistent with the OSS ModelVersion.from_proto guard.
Symptom: A Unity Catalog model version with no deployment job reported deployment_job_state as a non-None object whose job_id was empty and whose job_state was DEPLOYMENT_JOB_CONNECTION_STATE_UNSPECIFIED, so callers checking `is None` or truthiness were misled into thinking a deployment job existed.
Constraints: Applies to singular message fields only, where HasField is valid (verified for deployment_job_state on both ModelVersion and ModelVersionInfo protos). Does not apply to repeated fields or scalar fields, which have no presence check via HasField.
applies: Any change to how Unity Catalog model versions (including search results) are converted from protos to MLflow entities; does not cover the OSS (non-UC) registry path.
says: The model version details page shows a blank deployment job when none exists.
Hide the deployment job status card if no deployment job was ever scheduled.
Catalog registered models display empty deployment jobs with an unspecified connection state.
Models without deployment jobs should not display an empty job status panel.
Model versions falsely appear as connected to a deployment job in catalog search.
search: Unity Catalog model version converters must map optional message fields like deployment_job_state using ModelVersionDeploymentJobState.from_proto(...) if uc_proto.HasField('deployment_job_state') else None so unset fields evaluate to None. This applies to model_version_from_uc_proto and model_version_search_from_uc_proto in mlflow/utils/_unity_catalog_utils.py, as well as model_version_from_uc_native_proto and model_version_search_from_uc_native_proto in mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/uc_native_rest_store.py. The rule applies to singular message fields where HasField is valid, and does not apply to scalar fields, repeated fields, or open-source non-Unity Catalog registry paths.
